headline: Refuge ceremony timer
intro: Record the exact wall-clock moment of each vow — Buddha, Dharma, Sangha — to the millisecond. Built for retreat timekeepers.

about.title: A record, not a stopwatch
about.body: Timekeeper captures the exact wall-clock moment a person completes each phase of a refuge ceremony. Nothing counts up or down. Each tap stores a timestamp to the millisecond and never recomputes it afterward — so the record stays faithful to when the timekeeper tapped, as close as possible to the preceptor's snap.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.body: The app is built for retreat timekeepers running Worlds of Wisdom-style ceremonies and similar threefold refuge rites. The preceptor and participants never touch the app — only the timekeeper does, one aspirant at a time, moving through Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha before the next person begins.

features.title: What you get
items: Millisecond timestamps for Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha — one tap per phase.
Offline-ready PWA: works on retreat wifi after a single online visit.
CSV export per person or for the whole retreat, plus shareable record cards.
Undo and redo when you need to correct a moment without losing the session.

steps.title: Add people
steps.body: Name each aspirant and set the retreat.

steps.title: Check the clock
steps.body: Verify time zone and network time before you begin.

steps.title: Record each snap
steps.body: One tap per phase — export CSV or share cards after.

footnote: Offline-ready after one visit. No account needed.
